articles.title: Revelio Public Labor Statistics Reports 19.4k U.S. Jobs Gained in March
articles.mainIdea: Revelio Public Labor Statistics Reports 19.4k U.S. Jobs Gained in March
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Revelio Public Labor Statistics Reports 19.4k U.S. Jobs Gained in March. Revelio Labs today released its March edition of Revelio Public Labor Statistics (RPLS), a monthly data release delivering transparent and reliable insights into the U.S. labor market. The latest data indicates a gain of 19,400 jobs in March, a modest gain in comparison to last month's loss, and in line with expectations.
